description.value:
You deliver a perfectly crafted command with the power of your voice, triggering mass reboots and shaking bodies apart. You deal 10d8 sonic damage to all creatures in the area. Each creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage. Creatures with the tech trait become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 1}, and creatures without the tech trait are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Deafened] for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage. Creatures with the tech trait become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{Glitching 2}, and creatures without the tech trait are deafened for 1 minute.
